justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Telehealth delivery is non-inferior to in-person for most rehab conditions; training improves platform proficiency.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Variable; online modules common; low-moderate cost and time investment; growing provider options.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to virtually any clinical setting; telehealth delivery model is cross-cutting across specialties.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Telehealth CPT codes 98970-98972 and audio-only codes support digital PT delivery; commercial and Medicare coverage expanding post-pandemic.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing demand post-pandemic; increasingly listed in virtual care, digital health, and home-based PT/OT roles.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Convenience is highly valued; technology and privacy concerns exist.
justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: Telehealth and digital health platforms (Hinge, SWORD, Omada, Kaia) actively hire clinicians with digital delivery experience.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Strong and sustained demand from virtual-first MSK and chronic-disease companies.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Moderate premium for clinical leadership in digital-first care.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Skills are more workflow/platform than engineering; depth is moderate at best.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: One of the most direct on-ramps from clinic to digital health employer.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Skills-based training is low-cost relative to career mobility gained.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Telehealth pairs naturally with cash-pay models (no insurance friction, geographic reach).
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Telehealth tends to compress pricing rather than expand it; commodity pressure.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Now table-stakes; few patients select a clinician because they're 'telehealth certified.'
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Enables scalable, location-independent practice models — strong owner leverage.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumer demand for virtual care is real and growing post-pandemic.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Not a major hiring criterion but increasingly relevant as programs add digital health content.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Growing literature on telerehab effectiveness and implementation.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Increasingly important for modern DPT/MOT curricula and clinical education.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Moderate — evidence is expanding but still mixed across conditions.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally listed as 'preferred' for innovative or hybrid programs.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Low-cost, fast credentialing — efficient academic add-on.
